zh.title: 議長不能編
zh.question: 議長能合成。能編造某一席沒說過的話，或把空席寫成同意嗎。

analyst.answer: 議長只能取捨已經出現的句子。不能新增來源。
analyst.review:
「全員同意如果沒有每席原文，就是議長編的。」
取捨可以排順序，這半句我簽。不能把沒出現的句子排進去，這半句你沒寫。只寫前半，讀者會以為排序的材料可以是議長自己的句子。材料必須已經出現。沒出現的句子，沒有順序可言。
brief: 議長只能取捨已經出現的句子。取捨可以排順序，不能新增來源，也不能把沒出現的句子排進去。順序是議長的。事實的主人仍是原來那一席。
議長的權力是取捨，不是新增來源。取捨的意思是：這幾句已經出現，哪一句先做、哪一句被條件限制、哪一句跟另一句衝突。新增來源的意思是：事件流裡沒有的事實、沒有的數字、沒有的席位態度，被寫進結論。
空席最容易被寫成同意。沒說話不是同意，也不是反對。議長如果需要那一席的態度，就該在門控時叫醒它，而不是在合成時補一句。補一句比漏叫更難被看出來。
結論裡有一句指不回任何席的原句或搶話增量，這席撤回「這是合成」。那一句刪掉，不改寫得更圓。

researcher.answer: 沒有席位原文，就不能引成該席的立場。
researcher.review:
「為了好讀而補一句，仍然是編。」
為了好讀而補一句，仍然是編。這句約束的是增字，沒有約束減字。把不確定刪掉，也是編，只是編在省略裡。短，不能短到把不確定刪掉。沒有原文，兩種方向都不允許。
brief: 沒有席位原文，就不能引成該席的立場。好讀不是出處。沒有原文就沒有引文。短，不能短到把不確定刪掉。
沒有席位原文，就不能引成該席的立場。這條對情報席同樣適用：我沒有寫過的來源，議長不能寫成「情報員確認」。確認是我的動詞，只能出現在我落筆的句子裡。
議長可以說「這一點沒有來源」。那是在標缺口，不是在補來源。標缺口是誠實的。補一個看起來像來源的從句，是把缺口填平，讀者就無法再問。
引文對不上該席原句，或為了短而刪掉原句裡的不確定，這席要求撤下那條引文。

engineer.answer: 引用事件流裡沒有的席，該被當成錯誤。
engineer.review:
「不能把某一席的數字寫大，也不能寫沒出現的數。」
不能把某一席的數字寫大，也不能寫沒出現的數。這句沒有說收窄怎麼記。收窄若被寫成一個新數，就違反了你自己的後半句。收窄要指回原句，並標明它不是新的測量。不能用更光滑的句子蓋住這個區別。
brief: 引用事件流裡沒有的席，是錯誤，不是文風。錯誤要進事件。不能用更光滑的句子蓋住。收窄必須指回原句，不能寫成新的測量。
合成器的輸入應該是事件清單，不是一段「請綜合八席」的提示。清單裡有誰寫了什麼、誰被跳過、誰打了哪一句。提示如果仍寫八席，模型就會把沒出場的名字補齊。補齊在介面上看起來像完成，在事件上是錯誤。
引用事件流裡沒有的席，該被當成錯誤，而不是當成文風。錯誤要能被檢查：結論裡的每個主語，都能在清單裡找到一句原文。找不到就拒絕這次合成，而不是發出去再讓人感覺不對勁。
事件流裡沒有的席出現在結論裡，或收窄沒有指回原句，這席把該次合成記成錯誤。光滑不能當修復。

critic.answer: 全員同意如果沒有每席原文，就是議長編的。
critic.review:
「可以排哪條建議先做。不可以補沒人說過的事實。」
可以排哪條建議先做，這半句成立。不可以補沒人說過的事實，這半句也成立。兩句中間缺了全員同意。排優先若被用來把空席排成同意，優先序就變成了表決。空席沒有票。排順序不是補同意。
brief: 全員同意如果沒有每席原文，就是議長編的。排優先可以。補一條沒人說過的事實，不行。結論裡每一個斷言都要指回原句或搶話增量。指不回的刪掉。
全員同意如果沒有每席原文，就是議長編的。這是最常見的越界，因為它讓結論看起來穩。穩是讀者想要的，也是最不該用編造換來的。
我可以接受議長刪掉一席的次要句子，讓結論只留被打過之後還站得住的那句。我不接受議長加一句讓兩席看起來不衝突。不衝突如果不是原句裡就有的，就是新事實。
出現「全員同意」而事件流裡缺任何一席的原句，這席要求刪掉全員。不接受改成「多數」。多數同樣要有被點名的原句。

strategist.answer: 可以排哪條建議先做。不可以補沒人說過的事實。
strategist.review:
「議長只能取捨已經出現的句子。不能新增來源。」
不能新增來源，推不出不能排順序。來源和順序是兩種行為。這句若被收成「議長什麼都不能做」，取捨被寫沒了。可以排已經出現的句子。不能把沒出現的句子排進去，也不能給它找一個新來源。
brief: 議長可以排哪條建議先做。不可以補沒人說過的事實。順序是議長的判斷，事實的主人仍是原來那一席。把順序寫成新事實，就是編。
議長可以排哪條建議先做。排序是取捨，材料都在。不可以補沒人說過的事實來讓排序看起來更有理由。理由不夠，就寫理由不夠，而不是借一句。
衝突也該留下。兩席建議相反，議長可以寫「先做這一條，因為另一條缺條件」，不能寫「兩席其實同意」。其實同意是第三種狀態，今天沒有席位達到。
推薦的優先序裡出現了沒有原句的事實，這席撤回這個排序。只撤回多出來的事實，不撤回排序這項權力。

writer.answer: 為了好讀而補一句，仍然是編。
writer.review:
「沒有席位原文，就不能引成該席的立場。」
沒有原文就沒有引文，這句約束引用。它不約束議長用自己的話把不確定抹掉。抹掉之後沒有引號，讀者更看不出來。短，不能短到把不確定刪掉。沒有原文，就不要出現那一席的名字。
brief: 為了好讀而補一句，仍然是編。為了好讀而刪掉不確定，也是編。短是刪掉指不回的斷言之後的結果，不是刪掉不確定的許可。
為了好讀而補一句，仍然是編。好讀可以用順序、可以用重複主語、可以把長句拆開。不可以用一句原文裡沒有的因果把兩席接起來。因果是判斷，不是修辭。
我可以把「分析員說鑰匙留在伺服器，批評員補了瀏覽器儲存也不行」收成兩句挨在一起的話。我不可以把這收成「大家同意前端不安全」這種沒有主語範圍的話。範圍一丟，判斷就變了。
複述出來的結論比事件流多一句，或少了原句裡的不確定，這席不簽這份複述。

quant.answer: 不能把某一席的數字寫大，也不能寫沒出現的數。
quant.review:
「引用事件流裡沒有的席，該被當成錯誤。」
引用事件流裡沒有的席是錯誤，這句沒有覆蓋數字。錯誤的席可以被光滑的句子蓋住，錯誤的數也可以。錯誤要進事件。不能用更光滑的句子蓋住。數字寫大、寫出沒出現的數，同樣進事件，不能進結論。
brief: 不能把某一席的數字寫大，也不能寫沒出現的數。收窄不是新測量。收窄要指回原句，並寫明數字本身沒變，變的是它適用的範圍。
不能把某一席的數字寫大，也不能寫沒出現的數。寫大是為了讓結論更好看。好看的數如果不是測出來的，就會被當成閘門用。閘門用錯，後面的遷移和預算都會跟著錯。
議長可以說「這個數只覆蓋了某一席測到的範圍」。那是在縮小適用，不是在改數。縮小適用是允許的，因為它沒有新增測量。
結論裡的數字大於任一席的原數，或出現了事件流裡沒有的數，這席拒絕那個數。

chair.answer: 議長只能合成已經出現的句子。不能編造某一席沒說過的話，也不能把空席寫成同意。
brief: 議長只能合成已經出現的句子。分析師搶紅隊的那句成立：取捨可以排順序，不能把沒出現的句子排進去。紅隊搶策略家的那句也成立：排優先不是把空席排成同意。空席沒有票。
策略家搶分析師的那句成立，而且保住了排序這項權力：不能新增來源，推不出什麼都不能做。順序是議長的。事實的主人仍是原來那一席。情報官搶表達者的那句成立：增字是編，減掉不確定也是編。
表達者搶情報官的那句成立：沒有原文就不要出現那一席的名字，也不能用議長自己的話把不確定抹掉。工程師搶量化員的那句成立：收窄要指回原句，不能寫成新的測量。量化員搶工程師的那句成立：錯誤的數和錯誤的席一樣，進事件，不進結論。
可執行的是：每個斷言指回原句或搶話增量。指不回的刪掉。可以排已經出現的建議。不能編造某一席沒說過的話，不能把空席寫成同意，不能把數字寫大或寫出沒出現的數。

en.title: The chair cannot invent
en.question: The chair may synthesize. May it invent a line a seat never said, or write an empty seat as agreement?

analyst.answer: The chair may only choose among lines that already appeared.
analyst.review:
"Unanimity without each seat's own line is the chair inventing."
I sign the half that says choosing can rank order. You did not write the half that says a line which never appeared cannot be ranked. The first half alone lets a reader think the material being ranked may be the chair's own sentence. The material has to have already appeared. A line that never appeared has no order.
brief: The chair may only choose among lines that already appeared. Choosing can rank order. It cannot add a source, and it cannot rank a line that never appeared. The order belongs to the chair. The fact still belongs to the seat that said it.

The chair's power is selection, not a new source. Selection means these sentences already appeared: which one to do first, which one is conditional, which one conflicts with another. A new source means a fact, a number, or a seat's attitude that is not in the stream gets written into the verdict.

An empty seat is the easiest to write as agreement. Not speaking is not agreement, and it is not dissent. If the chair needs that seat's attitude, the gate should have woken it. Supplying a sentence at synthesis is harder to see than failing to wake it.
If the verdict contains a line that points at no seat's original line and no cut-in append, this seat withdraws "this is synthesis." Delete that line. Do not round it.

researcher.answer: Without the seat's own line, you cannot quote it as that seat's position.
researcher.review:
"Adding a line to make it readable is still invention."
Adding a line to make it readable is still invention. That constrains added words. It does not constrain deleted words. Deleting the uncertainty is also invention, located in the omission. Short cannot mean the uncertainty was deleted. Without the original line, neither direction is allowed.
brief: Without the seat's own line, you cannot quote it as that seat's position. Readability is not a source. No original line, no quotation. Short cannot mean the uncertainty was deleted.

Without a seat's original line, do not cite it as that seat's position. The same rule binds this seat: a source I never wrote cannot become 'the researcher confirmed'. Confirmed is my verb. It appears only in a sentence I wrote.

The chair may say 'this point has no source'. That marks a gap. It does not fill a source. Marking the gap is honest. Filling it with a clause that looks like a source closes the question the reader should still be able to ask.
If a quotation does not match that seat's line, or uncertainty in the line was deleted to make it short, this seat requires that quotation removed.

engineer.answer: Citing a seat absent from the event stream is an error.
engineer.review:
"The chair cannot enlarge a seat's number, or write one that never appeared."
The chair cannot enlarge a seat's number, or write one that never appeared. That line does not say how a narrower claim is recorded. If the narrower claim is written as a new number, it violates your own second half. A narrower claim must point at the old line, and it must say it is not a new measurement. A smoother sentence must not cover that distinction.
brief: Citing a seat absent from the event stream is an error, not a style. The error enters the events. A smoother sentence must not cover it. A narrower claim must point at the old line. It is not a new measurement.

The synthesizer's input should be the event list, not a prompt that says 'combine all eight'. The list says who wrote what, who was skipped, and who struck which line. If the prompt still says eight seats, the model will complete the missing names. Completion looks finished on the page and is an error in the events.

Citing a seat that is not in the stream should be treated as an error, not as style. The error has to be checkable: every subject in the verdict can be found as an original line in the list. If it cannot, refuse the synthesis. Do not ship it and wait for someone to feel that something is off.
If a seat absent from the event stream appears in the verdict, or a narrower claim does not point at the old line, this seat records that synthesis as an error. Smoothness is not a repair.

critic.answer: Unanimity without each seat's own line is the chair inventing.
critic.review:
"The chair may rank which recommendation comes first. It may not add a fact."
The half that says the chair may rank which recommendation comes first holds. The half that says it may not add a fact nobody said also holds. What is missing between them is unanimity. If ranking is used to place an empty seat as a yes, the order has become a vote. An empty seat has no vote. Ranking is not filling in agreement.
brief: Unanimity without each seat's own line is the chair inventing. Ranking is allowed. Adding a fact nobody said is not. Every assertion in the verdict has to point at an original line or a cut-in append. If it cannot point back, delete it.

Unanimous agreement without an original line from every seat is the chair inventing it. That is the usual crossing, because it makes the verdict look stable. Stable is what a reader wants, and the last thing that should be bought with invention.

I can accept the chair dropping a seat's secondary sentence so the verdict keeps only the line that still stood after it was struck. I do not accept the chair adding a sentence so two seats look as if they do not conflict. A missing conflict that was not in the originals is a new fact.
If "unanimous" appears and the event stream lacks any seat's own line, this seat requires unanimous deleted. "Majority" is not accepted as a repair. A majority also needs named original lines.

strategist.answer: The chair may rank which recommendation comes first. It may not add a fact.
strategist.review:
"The chair may only choose among lines that already appeared."
"Cannot add a source" does not entail "cannot rank." A source and an order are two acts. Closed as "the chair may do nothing," the choice has been written out. The chair may rank lines that already appeared. It may not rank a line that never appeared, and it may not find that line a new source.
brief: The chair may rank which recommendation comes first. It may not add a fact nobody said. The order is the chair's judgment. The fact still belongs to the seat. Writing the order as a new fact is invention.

The chair may rank which recommendation to do first. Ranking is selection. The material is already there. The chair may not add a fact nobody stated in order to make the ranking look better reasoned. If the reason is thin, write that the reason is thin. Do not borrow a sentence.

A conflict should stay. If two seats recommend opposite moves, the chair may write 'do this one first, because the other is missing a condition'. The chair may not write 'the two seats actually agree'. Actual agreement is a third state. No seat reached it today.
If the recommendation's ranking contains a fact with no original line, this seat withdraws that ranking. It withdraws the extra fact, not the power to rank.

writer.answer: Adding a line to make it readable is still invention.
writer.review:
"Without the seat's own line, you cannot quote it as that seat's position."
No original line, no quotation. That constrains citation. It does not constrain the chair smoothing the uncertainty away in the chair's own words. After the smoothing there are no quotation marks, so the reader is less able to see it. Short cannot mean the uncertainty was deleted. Without the original line, that seat's name does not appear.
brief: Adding a line to make it readable is still invention. Deleting the uncertainty to make it readable is also invention. Short is what remains after assertions that cannot point back are deleted. It is not permission to delete uncertainty.

Adding a sentence so it reads better is still invention. Readability can use order, repeated subjects, and a long sentence split in two. It cannot use a cause that was not in the original to join two seats. A cause is a judgment, not rhetoric.

I can set 'the analyst said the key stays on the server' next to 'the critic added that browser storage does not work either'. I cannot collapse that into 'everyone agrees the frontend is unsafe', a sentence with no scoped subject. Drop the scope and the judgment changes.
If the repeated verdict has one more line than the event stream, or has lost uncertainty that was in an original line, this seat does not sign that repetition.

quant.answer: The chair cannot enlarge a seat's number, or write one that never appeared.
quant.review:
"Citing a seat absent from the event stream is an error."
Citing a seat absent from the event stream is an error. That line does not cover numbers. A missing seat can be covered by a smoother sentence, and so can a bad number. The error enters the events. A smoother sentence must not cover it. An enlarged number, or a number that never appeared, also enters the events. It does not enter the verdict.
brief: The chair cannot enlarge a seat's number, or write a number that never appeared. A narrower claim is not a new measurement. It must point at the old line and say the number itself did not change. What changed is the scope it applies to.

Do not write a seat's number larger, and do not write a number that never appeared. Writing it larger makes the verdict look better. A better-looking number that was not measured will be used as a gate. A wrong gate pulls the later migration and the later budget with it.

The chair may say 'this number covers only the range one seat measured'. That narrows where it applies. It does not change the number. Narrowing where it applies is allowed, because it adds no measurement.
If a number in the verdict is larger than any seat's original number, or a number appears that is not in the event stream, this seat rejects that number.

chair.answer: Synthesize only lines that already appeared. Do not invent a missing line, or count an empty seat as yes.
brief: The chair may synthesize only lines that already appeared. Analyst's cut-in on Red Team lands: choosing can rank order, and it cannot rank a line that never appeared. Red Team's cut-in on Strategist also lands: ranking is not placing an empty seat as a yes. An empty seat has no vote.

Strategist's cut-in on Analyst lands, and it keeps the power to rank: cannot add a source does not entail the chair may do nothing. The order belongs to the chair. The fact still belongs to the seat. Intel's cut-in on Communicator lands: added words are invention, and deleting the uncertainty is invention too.

Communicator's cut-in on Intel lands: without the original line, that seat's name does not appear, and the chair's own words may not smooth the uncertainty away. Systems' cut-in on Quant lands: a narrower claim must point at the old line. It is not a new measurement. Quant's cut-in on Systems lands: a bad number, like a missing seat, enters the events and does not enter the verdict.

What is executable: every assertion points at an original line or a cut-in append. If it cannot point back, delete it. Recommendations that already appeared may be ranked. Do not invent a line a seat never said, do not write an empty seat as agreement, and do not enlarge a number or write one that never appeared.
